notes.title: Golden Fish Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/5a5a848887f27ab79f341906976d21b282417a64.png
Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

The Golden Fish is now live ːPfishː

The Golden Fish is a spawn that will appear at level 5 or higher and has a base value of 100 coins for catching it. It will roughly spawn once every minute (though its spawn rate is also affected by your level, so at higher levels it can spawn much faster). Your garden expansions also determine how many can exist at the same time (like with regular fish).

The Golden Fish is much more prone to jumping, so it should give you ample opportunity to catch it, and even if you miss it, it will turn around and come back to continue swimming in the waters until you do.  ːPdolphː


 Let me know if there is any issues or problems with the new update! ːPufoː 


You can also follow my Steam Developer Page to get automatically notified of any of my releases! ːPcatː

Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

Another update is out! ːPduckː

Among some tweaks and adjustments the most notable change is an update in the engine that should improve performance a bit for some people and especially where the game ran progressively slower over time as it was left open. There was some objects in previous builds (mainly golden acorns that could "fall off the stage" with enough velocity as they hit the ground at high speed and water drips left behind by fish on the ground) that did not get cleared out properly and made it so the total object count progressively increased as the minutes went by. This "item creep" should now be fixed making it more stable in these areas. ːPfishː

notes.title: Update 1.1.6 - Cinematic Mode
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/aa58a7d14837cb6ce0ea8e5499887aac3fb5b5db.png
Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

Another update is out! ːPduckː

If you leave the game running without any input (including not moving the mouse) for 60 seconds the game will now enter a mode where it will slowly pan back and forth over your garden. The HUD will be hidden and some elements like numbers and save icons etc will also be hidden to make sure only the actual going ons in the garden will be displayed. Helpers and everyone and everything working and producing in the garden will continue to work and earn as normal though so the numbers and other things becoming hidden is only for visual effect. It will look a bit like in that bottom gif below (with the dolphin swimming). At any time you can press any button to return to normal play. If for any reason you don't want the game to enter this mode after a set amount of time there is also possible to toggle this off with a new button in the options. ːPfishː

You can also press the F3 key at any time to enter cinematic mode. 

Also if anyone captures any nice footage of their garden in gif format (preferable in similar format as the gifs below) (personally I like to use Ezgif for making gifs) please upload them to the Discord (https://discord.gg/X3RmAfjBa3) (or any other place where you can upload and let me know) and I would be happy to post the image on screenshotsaturday on twitter (15mb size limit per image) ːPhelperː

notes.title: Upcoming Cinematic Mode Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/f9398b8eff87cfb79e2fda1f8b63124bb1506c9c.png
Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

I just want to make a note on an upcoming update. ːPduckː

I am currently working on an update that will add a "Cinematic Mode" to the game. 
After a set amount of time (or with a button prompt) the game will enter a mode where it will slowly pan back and forth over your garden. The HUD will be hidden and some elements like number blitters and save icons etc will also be hidden to make sure only the actual going ons in the garden will be displayed. Helpers and everyone and everything working and producing in the garden will continue to work and earn as normal though so the numbers and other things becoming hidden it is only visual. It will look a bit like in that bottom gif below (with the dolphin swimming). At any time you can press a button to return to normal play. If for some reason you don't want the game to enter this mode after a set amount of time there will also be possible to toggle it off with a new button in the options. ːPfishː

I just read a latest review on the game and that user wrote: "It puts joy into my soul and i dont mind just sitting listening to the game and watch it for 4hours straight". It is exactly this sort of thing this will be intended for ːPhhelperː 

I don't have a set date for the update as I need to test it some more to make sure any potential issues or new bugs are taken care off before making it live. ːPufoː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/d263331bb31e4c89b29263ad3efd6f5b5b7f7c25.png
Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

Another update is out! ːPduckː

I am still trying to optimize more for later levels and really big gardens. ːPcatː

Among minor fixes the way saving is handled has got a new revision again to hopefully make things a bit smoother. There was an issue in the game when the player has reached very high levels and golden acorn production where the game would constantly fire saving events on a loop when the Helpers picked up the acorns or when holding down the right mouse button to scroll and this has been resolved and will hopefully make scrolling with the mouse smoother in these instances (keyboard scrolling is not affected though and had no issue). ːPfrogː

Also a note on saving. The game automatically saves the game at frequent intervals but as in any other game it is of course best to quit the game when not in the middle of a game saving event. To save and quit proper it is a good practice to enter the options menu to quit (bottom right cogwheel button). The game will automatically save the game upon entering the options and then you can quit the game with the in-game quit option or just alt-f4 from there and you will be sure the game has saved all of your latest progression before leaving. ːPhhelperː

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 - Legacy Achievements
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/f20bb51f7a90219dca8fc9367c9fd819bbd11b85.png
Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

Many players have asked for more Achievements and even to bring over some from Plantera 1. Initially I only wanted to have unique Achievements for Plantera 2 but I have decided to carry over 10 "Legacy Achievements" from the first game. 

I want to make sure that any new achievements will not be too tedious though so I decreased the Wack a Mole Achievement from 50 bashes to 10. 

A tip for anyone hunting the elusive Moles: They always appear in your field of view so you can just wait for them and you do not have to scroll around to look for them and they should at least appear once a minute! 

So far all the new achievements are only in English but I should hopefully be able to add in all the localization for them today! ːPduckː

Of course for anyone who have already fulfilled the requirements for the new achievements they should unlock when you start up the game. With the exception of the Mole that need 10 new bashes on his head. If there is any issue or problem with the achievement just reach out on Discord, Steam or the forums and I will help you out! ːPhhelperː

Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː 

This update mainly reduces the max cap on the amount of Helpers to 200. This is to reduce slowdowns for the players who have reached these insanely high levels where the amount of Helpers just keep on increasing until they overflow the whole game area since there is no way currently to manually decrease them ingame. I never expected anyone to get close to these numbers but I always underestimate the tenacity of some players to push past all limits ːPdogː

If for some inexplicable reason someone prefer to play in Helper slow motion mode I could put in a way to revert the cap (which previously was set to 999), if so just reach out and I will put in a way in the game ːPhhelperː 

A bug was also fixed where you could stack windmills on top of each other.

And the fix from 1.0.4 where the visual cap of the Deco Point display was massively increased.

Hopefully this update will not cause the Helpers to go on a strike again! ːPhelperːːPhelperːːPhelperː

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/365c5655ef31cd81aa40efff01dd91d8781aa7eb.png

Hi everybody! ːPhelperː

First I must say thank you so much!! The launch has been fantastic so far and so much fun! Doing everything solo it is a bit overwhelming to handle everything when it is all rushing in and I feel I am being stretched a bit thin currently, but I hope to soon be able to start working on the first updates!

Please join the Steam forum or Discord discussions if you have suggestions or fun ideas!

I will soon also add Trading Cards, Badges and Emoticons!

I have some ideas already for updates, but the plan is not currently set in stone and could change around. 

Some of those current ideas are:

- Possibility to tame the mean critters
- Possibility to "posses" creatures like the Helpers and move around and harvest crops manually, or fly or swim around as birds or fish etc
- A cinematic mode where the garden pans back and forth when idle so you can have it showing in the background and being nice to look at
- Minigames like digging around for treasure with the mole and other ideas
- Many players have also asked for more achievements

Also all suggestions for fun animals to add and a fitting produce for them would be welcome! 

Discord: https://discord.gg/X3RmAfjBa3 

(Tiny) Update:

- Rebalanced some sounds. Mainly the coin pickup sound when grabbing coins from the Loot Hero

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/167167004c43a6ff076519babea3b9f291b03701.png

Hi everybody. ːPhelperː

I just wanted to make a quick status update since I know that it was a long time since the last announcement. The reason for not having a new announcement in a long time is that the game is feature complete so there have not really been anything "new and exciting" to report :) 

Right now I am basically doing runs of the game to see that everything is as I want it to be and as polished as I can make it before sending it out for bug testing. The last "run" I did I did find some things that I wanted to change so that is basically what I am doing now. One of the thing was implementing a "Tool Tip" that appears over buttons etc to better explain what they do. The other one was to make outlines on everything when you mouse over items when you select things to Move and Trash. This was quite time consuming though since I have to create outlines by hand for everything.

Also I created a Bee that I might implement.. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/b7cc7dbda0483043b352ea166ec56e3fb6255a7b.gif

I know it has taken a very very long time, much longer than I myself ever anticipated and even though there is almost 3 times more objects than in the first Plantera I was expecting to be finished much sooner. However I will never rush anything out before I think it is fully complete. 

Anyhow my goal is to make runs of the game until I no longer find anything I really want to change or polish more. Then I will localize the game and send it out to some testers. Then it will release :)
